research_estimand: Whether a small pre-retrieval default-off PM can learn when enabling one fixed Strategy Guidance resource produces material immediate-response benefit without unacceptable interaction-and-grounding risk and with lower unnecessary resource cost.

resource_definition.name: Strategy Guidance RAG
resource_definition.retrieves: one atomic support move with observable use conditions, prohibitions, burden, risk constraints, retrieval text and generator guidance
does_not_retrieve: medical legal financial or clinical factual advice

bank_qualification.stopping_rule: Stop when no additional atomic move passes source support, distinctness, reusability and risk-boundary review.

retrieval_contract.stage_1: transparent explicit-boundary safety burden and eligibility filtering
retrieval_contract.stage_2: one frozen lexical or BGE ranker selected on the same bank-disjoint train/calibration audit
retrieval_contract.topk_rule: Top-2 or Top-3 may be calibrated only on the same frozen catalog and ranking with Top-1 as a strict prefix.

external_roles.ESConv: single-session memory-unavailable R0 versus RS transfer
external_roles.EvoEmo_ES_MemEval_derived: longitudinal memory-available transfer using the exact same Strategy Guidance Bank; MP MS and ME provide separate memory content

not_supported: claim of comprehensive emotional-support scenario coverage

insufficient_source_fallback_order: narrow the supported RS claim and fail closed elsewhere
increase outcome-blind open coding within eligible ESConv train only
add independently sourced and explicitly disclosed public technique material then refreeze the entire shared Bank
use synthetic paraphrases only for retrieval robustness and never as independent provenance or utility evidence
forbidden_repairs: use ESConv validation or test to fill card gaps
use EvoEmo text or outcomes to tailor cards
use a different Strategy Bank per external domain
create topic-only variants to reach a card quota
current_decision: ESConv train is sufficient in volume for the required compact V1.5 Strategy Guidance RAG, but adequacy is conditional on inductive action coding, card-level source gates, retrieval qualification and clean-pair uptake.
